title: rubus conjungens
intro: Rubus conjungens, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry or Tibetan raspberry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Rubus conjungens include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Rubus conjungens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
